title: Winter Wonder Tour-A Journey Through the Tunnels Behind the Falls
includes: Journey Behind the Falls to explore cave-like tunnels behind the Falls "if option selected"
Hotel pickup and drop-off in the downtown Niagara Falls area
Whirlpool Rapids to experience the natural phenomenon of the Niagara River
Visit to the "Maple Trail" which includes a maple syrup and chocolate tour and tasting
Visit Canadian Horseshoe Falls, Queen Victoria Park and Clifton Hill
Skylon Tower Observation Deck for an amazing aerial view of the Falls"if option selected"
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Walking Requirements – Moderate walking required with short walks between attractions and stairs at some locations. Not wheelchair accessible due to winter conditions and terrain.
policies: Schedule Flexibility – We do our best to keep to schedule, but times may vary due to traffic, weather, or other unexpected delays.
Weather Conditions – Expect cold, misty conditions near the Falls. Waterproof layers strongly recommended for comfort, especially at Table Rock and Journey Behind the Falls.
Warm Winter Clothing – Winter boots with good grip, warm layers, waterproof jacket, gloves (bring a spare pair—one may get wet at Journey Behind the Falls), and a hat.
E-Tickets Accepted – Show your mobile voucher to the guide at boarding.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the magic of winter in Niagara Falls!
 Rated #1 for Best Value and Views, this all-time favorite tour features breathtaking sights throughout Niagara Falls. Highlights include a breath taking Journey Behind The Falls, a climb up the Skylon Tower, view the Niagara River Gorge, see the glistening Ice Formations at Niagara Falls and much more! 

This “all-time favorite” tour features just about something for everyone, from adventure and excitement to the most captivating views in Niagara Falls, Canada. Whether going on a Journey Behind the Falls or scaling the Skylon Tower for a birds-eye-view of Niagara Falls, the thrill of this tour will create a memory that will last a lifetime.
